title: Oversized League Prizes: card flavor text

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: Balduvian Chieftain who wants Varchild's head and laments lost storm-calling.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Enemy of the Balduvians whose head Lovisa seeks.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: Barbarian people led by Lovisa Coldeyes.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Speaker who wants to shake and rattle someone's brains.

entities.name: Ivory Tower
entities.description: Seat of scholars who reward those sacrificing power for knowledge.

entities.name: Lhurgoyf
entities.description: A monster whose appearance prompts Saffi's warning.

entities.name: Saffi Eriksdotter
entities.description: Warns Hans to run from the Lhurgoyf; these are her last words.

entities.name: Hans
entities.description: Companion told to run from the Lhurgoyf.

entities.name: Ib Halfheart
entities.description: Goblin tactician who urges not looking at a spirit.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: Wizard who will go to any length for eternal life.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Vampire called a beast and defiler by Ihsan's Shade.

entities.name: Ihsan's Shade
entities.description: Spirit who denounces Baron Sengir as the source of all his pain.

entities.name: Akin
entities.description: Seasoned askari who warns against taunting embermages.

entities.name: Lucilde Fiksdotter
aliases: Leader of the Order of the White Shield
entities.description: Leader of the Order of the White Shield who values honor over might.

entities.name: Order of the White Shield
entities.description: Knightly order led by Lucilde Fiksdotter.

entities.name: Shesul Fass
entities.description: Faerie bard who tells of Harthar's attack on a Force of Nature.

entities.name: Harthar
entities.description: Attacked a being sensing weakness and was killed.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Task mage; planeswalker; quipper about water mages and big ones fighting.

entities.name: Hanna
entities.description: Weatherlight navigator commenting on wizards.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Airship on which Hanna is navigator.

entities.name: Halvor Arenson
entities.description: Kjeldoran priest who recalls healers' work after floods.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Kjeldoran royal mage who speaks on the lessons of water.

entities.name: Afari
entities.description: Author of Tales, telling of a man who traded life for sand.

entities.name: Kifimbo
entities.description: Shadow Guildmage who finds planting cadaverous blooms filthy work.

entities.name: Kipkemboi
entities.description: Kukemssa pirate who praises wealth.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: Endbringer who writes with the blood of her students.

entities.name: Taraneh
entities.description: Suq'Ata mage who protests she signed nothing.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Wizard adept who jokes about Barrin's meditation and his own modesty.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Taught Ertai meditation.

entities.name: Rashida Scalebane
entities.description: Speaker forged a warrior by dragonfire.

entities.name: Grahilah
entities.description: Former trader of Amiqat.

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes declares peace will come only when Varchild's head is taken.
events.quote: Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head.

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir says they must shake her limbs and rattle her brains.
events.quote: We must shake her limbs and rattle her brains.

events.summary: Saffi Eriksdotter's last words warn Hans to run from the Lhurgoyf.
events.quote: Ach! Hans, run! It's the Lhurgoyf!

events.summary: Ib Halfheart urges people not to look at the spirit in hope it goes away.
events.quote: Don't look at it! Maybe it'll go away!

events.summary: Zur declares eternal life is worth any sacrifice.
events.quote: Eternal life is worth any sacrifice.

events.summary: Ihsan's Shade denounces Baron Sengir as the source of all his pain.
events.quote: The source of all my pain.

events.summary: Akin warns never to taunt an embermage.
Lucilde Fiksdotter says Barbarians will respect the Order's honor rather than its might.
events.quote: they will respect us for our honor.

events.summary: Shesul Fass recounts that Harthar attacked a being sensing weakness and died.
Jaya Ballard jokes about Pyroblast and pesky water mages.
events.quote: Just the thing for those pesky water mages.

events.summary: Hanna remarks that wizards begin by exiling themselves and end by exiling everyone else.
events.quote: It is the way of most wizards to begin by exiling themselves and to end by exiling everyone else.

events.summary: Halvor Arenson recalls floodwaters sweeping away trees, bridges and houses.
events.quote: My healers had much work to do.

events.summary: Lovisa Coldeyes recalls that her people once called down the storm.
events.quote: Once, our people could call down the storm itself to do our bidding.

events.summary: Afari's Tales tells of a man who traded his life for sand.
events.quote: In the end, he traded life for sand.

events.summary: Ertai suspects Barrin taught him meditation to shut him up.
events.quote: Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up.

events.summary: Rashida Scalebane says dragonfire forged her a warrior.

relations.quote: Peace will come only when we have taken Varchild's head.
Leader of the Order of the White Shield

relations.note: Shade blames Baron Sengir for its pain.
